lines.text: A song in Judah says salvation is the walls of the strong city, and the LORD is the Rock eternal.
God brings the lofty city down to the dust, where the feet of the oppressed trample it.
The singers wait for the LORD, and one says, "My soul longs for You in the night."
The singers say they gave birth to stone, but the LORD's dead will live and those in dust will sing.
God's people hide for seven days until the wrath passes, and the LORD will slay the dragon of the sea.
